programme.title: THE BOYS OF H COMPANY [P13]
programme.desc: In the war in the Pacific, Iwo Jima was crucial to the U.S. as an air base for long- range bombing missions against mainland Japan. The Japanese knew the island’s importance and spent years “digging in” in preparation for the inevitable U.S. attack. Seizing Iwo Jima was necessary, but the prize would not come easily. On the morning of February 19, 1945, the boys of H Company stormed the beaches at Iwo Jima, along with 60,000 other Marines. Through compelling first person accounts, dramatic recreations and archival footage, this two-hour docudrama follows in the boot steps of the boys of H Company as they fight one of the costliest battles in U.S. History.

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Hosts Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey to the heart of South Africa, where they reveal that the nation’s true brilliance shines not from its famous diamonds, but from the resilience and spirit of its people. The episode begins in Johannesburg, a city forged by gold and hardened by resistance. Kolyn and Lindsey delve into the profound legacy of Nelson Mandela, tracing his transformation from an activist to a revolutionary leader who introduced the mining charter. This segment explores how a history of struggle became a foundation for national strength. The narrative shifts from social history to the literal 'sparkle' of the land with a trip to the Kimberley Big Hole. Here, the team explores the origins of the global diamond rush. They meet Molefi Letsiki, a Diamondtaires and the world’s first Black Sightholder—one of only 70 globally—whose success is a testament to a legacy fulfilled. The deep dive continues 1,500 feet underground at the Venetia Mine. This offers a high-stakes, never-before-seen look at modern diamond production, highlighting the industry's critical shift toward community empowerment and sustainability. The episode concludes by examining the 'Future' of the facet. It showcases how South Africa's ancient craft and natural resources are being re-embraced by a new generation of leaders, artists, and entrepreneurs. Through every interview—from museum educators to diamond executives—one message remains clear: while the diamonds may glisten, the people are The Real Jewels Of South Africa.

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Hosts Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger journey to the heart of South Africa, where they reveal that the nation’s true brilliance shines not from its famous diamonds, but from the resilience and spirit of its people. The episode begins in Johannesburg, a city forged by gold and hardened by resistance. Kolyn and Lindsey delve into the profound legacy of Nelson Mandela, tracing his transformation from an activist to a revolutionary leader who introduced the mining charter. This segment explores how a history of struggle became a foundation for national strength. The narrative shifts from social history to the literal 'sparkle' of the land with a trip to the Kimberley Big Hole. Here, the team explores the origins of the global diamond rush. They meet Molefi Letsiki, a Diamondtaires and the world’s first Black Sightholder—one of only 70 globally—whose success is a testament to a legacy fulfilled. The deep dive continues 1,500 feet underground at the Venetia Mine. This offers a high-stakes, never-before-seen look at modern diamond production, highlighting the industry's critical shift toward community empowerment and sustainability. The episode concludes by examining the 'Future' of the facet. It showcases how South Africa's ancient craft and natural resources are being re-embraced by a new generation of leaders, artists, and entrepreneurs. Through every interview—from museum educators to diamond executives—one message remains clear: while the diamonds may glisten, the people are The Real Jewels Of South Africa.

programme.title: ICE COLD KILLERS S3 [P13]

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger venture beyond the mountains to explore the vibrant soul of South Africa, from the high-adrenaline wild of Kruger National Park to the trailblazing spirit of its first Black-owned winery. The journey begins in Mpumalanga, 'the place where the sun rises,' for an immersive safari experience in Kruger National Park. Accompanied by their daughter, Kynsley, the team experiences nature’s masterpiece firsthand, discovering that the 'wild' is as much about preservation as it is about the thrill of discovery. The narrative then shifts to Cape Town, a global cosmopolitan hub where the Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet. Standing atop the iconic Table Mountain, the hosts reflect on its history as a 'gift to the world' from Nelson Mandela. Deepening their cultural exploration, Kolyn and Lindsey visit the Lesedi Cultural Village to experience the living history of the Zulu people through dance, rhythm, and traditional delicacies. The celebration of South African excellence culminates at Klein Goederust, the first and only 100% Black-owned winery in the Franschhoek Valley. Through a moving conversation with founder Paul Siguqa, the episode highlights a legacy of resilience—transforming generations of farm labor into a future of ownership and Black excellence.

programme.title: What's The Difference? [U]
programme.desc: Join Afrina, Hanna, Panda and friends on ZooMoo to play our fun game show, 'What's The Difference?'. Did you know whales, monkeys and scorpions all have tails, but that they use them to do different things? Or that snails, snakes and naked mole rats all use different senses when they can't see very well? Did you know that ostriches, penguins and owls all have feathers, but that their feathers are all different for different reasons? Play 'What's The Difference?' with the ZooMoo crew and discover why animals think it's cool to be different!

programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.desc: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible interactions with predatory killer whales. The humpbacks also face a world full of human threats, from large container ships, to the impact of seismic testing in the search for oil and gas, now threatening their very survival once more.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating—and finest—moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and it's up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of America's largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

programme.title: Battle Of Okinawa In Color [P13]
programme.desc: Okinawa was the site of the last battle of the last great war of the 20th century, with a casualty rate in the tens of thousands. Through it all, military cameramen risked their lives to film the conflict, from brutal land combat to fierce kamikaze attacks at sea.

programme.title: Battle Of Midway: The True Story [P13]

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]
programme.desc: See ancient sea caves, modern golf courses, mysterious formations, and treacherous predators along Africa's South Coast.

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]

programme.title: Aerial Africa [P13]

programme.desc: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The world's largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Rediscover the Tet Offensive: two months of battles that killed more than 15,000 American and Allied troops, and triggered anti-war protests across the U.S. Explore reports, images, and combat footage, much of which hasn’t been seen since 1968.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Experience a chronological recounting of the Apollo 13 near-disaster, one of NASA’s most devastating—and finest—moments. Witness the events of April 1970 as they unfolded through news footage, mission control audio, and NASA archives.

programme.title: Mega Transports Specials [P13]
programme.desc: This giant magnet will revolutionize the world and energy production in the future. The world's largest nuclear fusion reactor is currently under construction in southern France.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the nest.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets [P13]
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the island's unique recipe for pesto.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets [P13]
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets [P13]
programme.desc: Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

programme.title: Reframed: Marilyn Monroe [P13]
programme.desc: This episode explores the young Norma Jeane. While showing talent and audacity, she turned her back on her difficult childhood and put herself on the radar in Hollywood as ‘Marilyn Monroe’.

programme.title: Reframed: Marilyn Monroe [P13]
programme.desc: This episode explores Marilyn’s defiance about posing nude and how it catapults her to stardom.

programme.title: Reframed: Marilyn Monroe [P13]
programme.desc: This episode explores Marilyn’s determination to become a serious actress and her departure from Twentieth Century Fox to start her own production company.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

programme.title: Nature Sanctuaries [P13]
programme.desc: Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earth's species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

programme.title: Wildest Survival [P13]
programme.desc: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

programme.title: Wildest Survival [P13]
programme.desc: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

programme.title: Wildest Survival [P13]
programme.desc: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.title: Battle Of Midway: The True Story [P13]
programme.desc: An inside look at the Battle of Midway, the aircraft used on both sides of the fight, and the dramatic story of one fighter pilot and his pivotal role in America’s first true victory of the Pacific War.

programme.title: The Lost Tapes [P13]
programme.desc: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Haonan brings Megan for a follow-up visit at the hospital and meets Gavin, Kelun and Mark. Upon seeing Megan, Mark behaves strangely, acting uptight and then leaving in a hurry. Gavin notices Mark's odd reaction and probes further.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Masahiko entices Shengyang and Director Pan with benefits, instigating them to breach the contract and frame Shanghao. Kensuke, Qianna, and Guan Zhong share the joyful news of Wenxue's unexpected pregnancy, leaving Wenxue feeling conflicted.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Guan Zhong stages a fake car accident and secretly films Junqiang assaulting someone. Rixin approaches Pinxuan to borrow money. Feeling dejected after being turned down, Rixin learns about Pinxuan's relationship with Dali.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Ruzhen menawarkan Ruo Lan dan Toto untuk tinggal di rumahnya tapi Ruo Lan teragak-agak. Chee Qian mahu segera selesaikan nafkah yang dituntut Shu Shu dengan menawarkan sebuah rumah sebagai sebahagian jalan penyelesaian nafkah.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Zhun Yu menyerahkan dirinya kepada Jin Ular Merah sebagai pertukaran untuk pembebasan Wen Jin. Jin Ular Merah memaksa Zhun Yu berkahwin dengannya. Dengan bantuan Dewa Raja Chen Huang, Zixian mencabar Jin Ular Merah.

programme.title: KEEP RUNNING: YELLOW RIVER 2
programme.desc: Episod ini seramai 7 ahli "Keep Running" dan artis jemputan Victor Qin dan Gong Lijiao berada di Lanzhou, Wilayah Gansu, China akan bersaing dalam siri permainan bertema "Makanan Tradisional Tempatan Dan Kesusasteraannya".

programme.title: THE LONGEST PROMISE
programme.desc: Shi Ying menggunakan kuasa Huang Tian untuk menumpaskan pengaruh Xi Yao ke atas Tentera Bing. Tentera Bing kehilangan pengaruh Xi Yao menjadi lemah dan berundur. Zhu Yan menyamar sebagai Yao Yu untuk mendekati Xi Yao.

programme.title: PROJECT LOVE SEASON 3
programme.desc: 8TV’s heartfelt programme Project Love Season 3 returns with warmth and purpose!Continuing the mission of the first 2 seasons touching hearts through real stories,Project Love Season 3 steps even closer into the everyday lives of ordinary Malaysians.

programme.title: LOVE VIRTUALLY
programme.desc: Cheng Cheng mendedahkan kisah silamnya bersama Dan yang membawa kepada ugutan daripada Natasha. Akibat ditekan, Cheng Cheng terpaksa menyerahkan teknologi ciptaannya kepada pasangan itu yang mahu menyalahgunakan dana yayasan kebajikan.

programme.title: THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Bound by an oath of brotherhood, legendary warrior Guan Yu (Donnie Yen) defies his captor and embarks on a perilous journey to reunite with his sworn brother, Liu Bei, facing relentless pursuit and testing the limits of his loyalty and honor.

programme.title: WEAVING A TALE OF LOVE S2
programme.desc: Xingjian memahami keadaan genting Xizhou yang dalam peperangan, jadi dia tinggalkan Liu Li tanpa notis. Puteri Linhai menawarkan harga begitu rendah untuk membeli aset keluarga Pei tapi percubaannya dimusnahkan ibu gundik Wu.

programme.title: WEAVING A TALE OF LOVE S2
programme.desc: Outside the Yunweidi Inn, the human trafficker Mi Dalang was lecturing the slave girl A Hong. The two had a fight in the courtyard. During the competition, A Hong shot out a flying knife, flew into the lobby.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 4 )
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan hos bersama empat orang tetamu jemputan yang merupakan hos TV dibahagikan kepada dua kumpulan yang masing-masing diketuai oleh Rickman dan Yun Mei Xin untuk mengambil bahagian dalam siri permainan di premis TV3.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Yu Hua mengingatkan Ho bahawa Jia Mei sedang membeli banyak saham Chuen Kuo Heng Tai di Bursa. Ho sengaja membocorkan berita negatif tentang syarikat itu untuk mendorong Jia Mei terus membelinya. Mengapa?

programme.title: NO RETURN
programme.desc: Pihak Polis menegaskan Shap-chat terlibat dengan kecurian wang dan pistol polis, dia dipenjarakan. Wai Ho yang berada di dalam penjara melindungi Shap-chat daripada dibuli. Fa Heow menggali tanah perkuburan Kwai-pi.

programme.title: STAND OR FALL
programme.desc: Peter dari Tiberson diberitahu bahawa Hengtian sekarang bekerjasama dengan Wanli, memaksa Tiberson menghentikan idea untuk menutup kedai di Wanli. Jing Zhiqiu mengekori suaminya yang ada urusan perniagaan di luar bandar.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Zi Tong pulih ingatannya dan menyalahkan diri kerana menyebabkan kecederaan Zi Sheng. An Jie pulih kesedaran dan mendapati dirinya berada dalam sungai. An Jie cuba mencari Ivan akhirnya berjaya menjumpai Ivan yang cedera parah.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Atas desakan An Jie, Ivan mengaku bahawa dia adalah budak lelaki yang menyelamatkan An Jie semasa kecil. Ivan terpaksa mematuhi arahan yang diberikan oleh Chang Sheng untuk menyelamatkan Miku, abang sebenar An Jie.

programme.title: CALL OF DESTINY
programme.desc: Rijin dan Kelan menemui Dingqin yang cedera parah. Sebelum pengsan, Dingqin menyerahkan kamera mikro yang merakam aksinya menjadi umpan demi memancing pembunuh sebenar, sehingga berlaku pergelutan sengit dan cubaan membakar bukti.

programme.title: MY SWEET MOBSTER
programme.desc: Ji Hwan menyediakan sebuah bilik kerja untuk Eun Ha dalam rumah. Pada hari berkenaan, semua pekerja Ji Hwan sengaja pulang lewat untuk memberi ruang kepada Ji Hwan dan Eun Ha supaya tidak diganggu. Namun berlaku perkara yang lucu.

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Dou Ming dan Wei Ting Yu yang saling menyukai satu sama lain, sering berjumpa secara rahsia. Hubungan mereka diperhatikan oleh Dou Zhao. Sementara itu Song Mo cuba meluahkan perasaannya kepada Dou Zhao, tetapi Dou Zhao menolak.

programme.title: BLOSSOM
programme.desc: Satu letupan berlaku di sebuah kilang mercun di ibu kota. Dou Zhao yang risau akan keselamatan Song Mo, cuba menceroboh masuk ke tapak kebakaran untuk mencari Song Mo tanpa menghiraukan keselamatan dirinya sendiri.

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amy's Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: Zhong Kui Exorcism
programme.desc: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

Born in Turkey and lived many years in China, she combines Ottoman and Asian culture in her timeless and much sought-after jewellery. In Thailand, meet Indian chef Garima Arora, who's passionate to change perceptions of Indian cuisine in her Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant, Gaa. programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.
